from pathlib import Path
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a mutable buffer before parsing."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":777,"var":"len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The copied bytes become the exact parser span."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":792,"var":"lexer.pos/end","code":".pos = data, .start = data, .end = (char *)data + len,","note":"The lexer tracks the attacker-controlled end pointer for the input."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":459,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '\"' && !strncmp(lexer->pos, \"\"\", 2)) return lex_multiline_string;","note":"A double-quote prefix routes parsing into the multiline-string scanner."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":342,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"advance_n(lexer, strlen(\"'''\") - 1);","note":"The scanner advances the cursor before checking for the terminator, so the first comparison happens from inside the body."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_multiline_string","line":345,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"if (!strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)) {","note":"The scanner performs a 3-byte comparison at the current cursor position, which may be adjacent to the end of the attacker buffer."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_error","line":329,"var":"lexer->state","code":"return lex_error(lexer, \"EOF while scanning multiline string\");","note":"If the input ends before a terminator is found, the lexer reports an error rather than crashing, so this candidate is still only a parser edge case."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')))
print('trace updated')
PY
